brief: Today's UPSC Intelligence Brief covering AI regulation, industrial decarbonization, Indo-Pacific strategy, space technological milestones, and coastal ecosystem preservation.

articles.title: National Artificial Intelligence Governance Framework & Regulatory Sandbox
articles.summary: The Union Government releases official guidelines establishing a risk-tiered regulatory framework for enterprise AI adoption and deployment.
prelims: Establishes an AI Safety Institute under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY).
Categorizes AI systems into Risk Tiers (Unacceptable, High, and Minimal Risk) inspired by global standards.
Provides a mandatory 'Regulatory Sandbox' for fintech and healthcare AI solutions before public release.
articles.mains: Use to discuss state regulation vs. technological innovation, ethical governance, and privacy protection in GS-2 (Governance) and GS-3 (Science & Tech).

articles.title: Strategic Expansion of Hydrogen Valleys under National Green Hydrogen Mission
articles.summary: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy notifies three new Green Hydrogen Valleys to boost localized production and application in heavy industries.
prelims: Target to produce 5 Million Metric Tonnes (MMT) of Green Hydrogen annually by 2030.
Hydrogen Valleys focus on co-locating renewable power generation, electrolyzer infrastructure, and industrial consumers.
Nodal execution agency is the Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI).
articles.mains: Incorporate as a critical case study for India's Panchamrit targets, industrial decarbonization, and renewable energy storage solutions.

articles.title: IORA Coastal Security & Maritime Domain Awareness Initiative
articles.summary: India hosts the Indian Ocean Rim Association workshop to bolster real-time maritime domain awareness and counter non-traditional security threats.
prelims: IORA was established in 1997 and currently comprises 23 member states bordering the Indian Ocean.
Secretariat is located in Ebene, Mauritius.
Focus areas include Maritime Safety, Trade Facilitation, Disaster Risk Management, and Blue Economy.
articles.mains: Cite when writing answers on India's SAGAR (Security and Growth for All in the Region) vision, net security provider role, and Indo-Pacific diplomacy.

articles.title: ISRO Successfully Tests Spatial Docking Systems for Chandrayaan-4
articles.summary: ISRO accomplishes crucial autonomous docking trials essential for the upcoming multi-module lunar sample return mission.
prelims: Chandrayaan-4 is designed as a lunar sample-return mission targeting the South Pole region.
Requires two LVM3 launch vehicles carrying distinct modules (Transfer, Lander, Ascender, and Re-entry).
Spatial docking enables autonomous joining of orbiting modules in lunar orbit.
articles.mains: Highlight as an example of self-reliance (Atmanirbharta) in advanced space technologies, deep-space operational maturity, and technological spin-offs.

articles.title: Integrated Blue Carbon Registry & Coastal Wetland Policy 2026
articles.summary: Ministry of Environment releases operational rules for integrating restored coastal mangroves into the national carbon offset market.
prelims: Leverages data from the MISHTI (Mangrove Initiative for Shoreline Habitats & Tangible Incomes) scheme.
Blue Carbon refers to carbon captured and sequestered by ocean and coastal ecosystems.
Wetlands are declared under the Ramsar Convention based on specific ecological criteria, including endemic biodiversity support.
articles.mains: Use to answer questions on nature-based solutions for climate adaptation, ecosystem restoration, and sustainable carbon credit markets.
